exposure: Herniated intervertebral disc at L5/S1 level
outcome: Radiating pain in the lower extremities
cohort: A woman in her 30s presented with cauda equina syndrome following a vaginal delivery.
finding: The report highlights the rare occurrence of postpartum cauda equina syndrome and emphasizes the importance of prompt diagnosis and timely management to prevent permanent neurological deficits.
mod_finding: The case describes cauda equina syndrome occurring specifically following a vaginal delivery.
